terra.problem: It gives the disciples’ inability as the whole reason the father cries out to Jesus. The text does not state his reason.
“No delay” adds timing the text does not give.
The passage does not say that nobody leaves the scene.
The text says Jesus gave the boy back to his father, not that the boy was in his father’s arms.
The passage does not say that nobody else takes the boy away.
The text does not say that nobody in the scene is carrying money.
The text does not say that nobody is holding a map.
Saying Jesus lets the picture do the talking overlooks that He then speaks and explains.
The text does not say the disciples are still arguing when Jesus has the child stand beside Him.
“Small enough to stand next to Him” does not make sense as a point about the child.
“Keep that in your pocket for the next card” refers to the lesson’s card structure.
Driving out demons is not John’s whole report. He also says they tried to stop the man and why.
John says the man does not accompany them. That does not establish whether he is part of their group.
Calling the Pharisees a group of religious leaders implies all Pharisees were leaders.
The man not accompanying the disciples does not establish that he was not beside them.
